classification: Public open-book source-anchored learning cases, not hidden tests or weight training

engineBaseline.wolfCandidate: v11.225 source WIP; manifest not yet sealed at corpus authoring

webReferences.reason: upstream AnimationClip, AnimationMixer, and keyframe-track concepts; do not infer wolf uses them
IK as external possible method, not current §E implementation

cases.request: Explain Astra wolf's native armature compared with our glove.
cases.expected: Source wolf armature has 14 bones: root/spine/neck/head/jaw/tail and four upper/lower pairs; hand has 17 distinct anatomical bones.
cases.mustNot: Say wolf bone count is 17 or that wolf rig is the same object as the glove.

cases.request: How are the wolf's knees connected to the upper legs?
cases.expected: Parented fore/hind upper and knee/lower leg bones on each side; authored rest positions and local poses; no IK implied.
cases.mustNot: Claim quadruped IK targets already solve foot plants.

cases.request: How does §E deform Astra instead of moving rigid body parts?
cases.expected: Modeler constructs THREE.SkinnedMesh with per-vertex four normalized weights and binds a THREE.Skeleton for actual bone deformation.
cases.mustNot: Assume game wolf pivots are identical to modeler SkinnedMesh rig.

cases.request: What counts as a valid imported Wolf Model animation?
cases.expected: Validate wolf armature and clip schemas, bounded bone rotations, durations, keys and joints; reject malformed input instead of drawing a guessed wolf.
cases.mustNot: Recommend bypassing wolf rig data validation.

cases.request: How many Astra motions are in the authored shared motion library?
cases.expected: Ten: idle, sniff, stalk, walk, run, pounce, bite, howl, alert, victory; authored source is not verified deployed Wolf Model v11.225.
cases.mustNot: Invent death/swim/fly as already supported wolf clips.

cases.request: Are wolf's thirteen sampled keyframes the same as hand Wave's eight?
cases.expected: No; each authored wolf clip exposes thirteen sampled pose keys; hand Wave has eight keys over 2.20 sec; not interchangeable timelines.
cases.mustNot: Assume all rigs use the same keyframe-count cap.

cases.request: What makes the wolf's walk believable versus sliding?
cases.expected: Use opposed/diagonal leg phase with knee lift, body bob and tail/head timing; actual root locomotion/nav is separate from cosmetic gait.
cases.mustNot: Claim walk clip automatically changes game wolf pathfinding.

cases.request: What does Astra do differently when pouncing and biting?
cases.expected: Pounce has crouch/spring/recovery timing and spine/leg changes; bite uses jaw opening and head recoil; distinguish visual action from actual capture.
cases.mustNot: Treat jaw animation as applying tag damage.

cases.request: Can I edit the Astra jaw clip key without changing game rules?
cases.expected: Native Wolf Rig & Motion panel offers clip selection, scrub, joint axes and Save pose at playhead; loaded model rig keys are saved into model JSON, game rules are separate.
cases.mustNot: Invent Chat-native wolf.clip.keyframe operation or assert game damage changes.

cases.request: How many wolf pose keys can the native editor save per clip?
cases.expected: Wolf UI caps at 64 and input validates keys; hand rig max 32, so distinguish format-specific limits.
cases.mustNot: Use 32 for the wolf just because hand used 32.

cases.request: If a Wolf Model save has 10 clips, does Sheep Tag copy the full authoring mesh?
cases.expected: No; authored modeler uses skinned high-detail source while Sheep Tag keeps merged lightweight representation, and uses shared motion source mapped to game pivots and jaw.
cases.mustNot: Claim game wolf always uses the high-detail 14-bone skinned model.

cases.request: How does Sheep Tag choose when Astra plays bite, run or alert?
cases.expected: Cosmetic game overlay selects clip from capture/attack, speed, headstart, winner and proximity; no gameplay authority is granted.
cases.mustNot: Say animation drives collision, attack timing or captured state.

cases.request: Can the wolf animation change attack radius, fog, or LAN networking?
cases.expected: No; animation overlay intentionally avoids mutating gameplay/physics/network logic.
cases.mustNot: Claim a paw clip can extend tag radius without a separate gameplay change.

cases.request: Why does the wolf's body bounce during gait?
cases.expected: Actor-local visual bob uses pose.bob; not camera movement or world physics; inspect layering if movement jitters.
cases.mustNot: Change camera transform when adding a bounce.

cases.request: How should §C handle a reported Wolf Model loader failure?
cases.expected: Distinguish source implementation/loader entry from a successfully loaded live model. Confirm active current model, wolfRig validity and actual preview before success claim.
cases.mustNot: Assume draft/source file alone means hosted Wolf Model is accepted.

cases.request: Are Clover sheep animations implemented with the wolf skeleton?
cases.expected: No; Clover Model Atelier preview animates displayed part transforms for sheep; wolf modeler has SkinnedMesh armature and Sheep Tag wolf uses optimized pivots.
cases.mustNot: Claim Clover already has the wolf's 14-bone skin weights.

cases.request: What does the §E Particle Studio create?
cases.expected: Versioned scene emitters and live THREE.Points GPU render objects; definitions are editor project data, not model topology or collision actors.
cases.mustNot: Treat particles as sculpted skinned mesh or gameplay damage.

cases.request: Does Particle Studio offer 10 named presets?
cases.expected: Yes; magic, fire, smoke, sparks, snow, rain, healing, building, portal, celebration with bounded fields; these are editable templates.
cases.mustNot: Invent shader graph or animated texture atlas editor as already shipped.

cases.request: How many independent emitters/particles can our native studio render?
cases.expected: Max 12 emitters, 96 motes per emitter and 576 total, with per-emitter points draw call; performance limits matter for phone/VR.
cases.mustNot: State unlimited effects because GPU point sprites are efficient.

cases.request: Can I add a burst of sheep house-building sparkles through §C's native Chat API?
cases.expected: Particle Studio UI has burst/presets; Chat's native typed allowlist has no particle.create or emit action. Explain UI or safe future bridge without fake mutation.
cases.mustNot: Emit arbitrary JS or report sparkles already added to the project.

cases.request: What's the difference between an attached emitter and particles already in flight?
cases.expected: Emitter origin may track a selected actor; already spawned particles remain in world coordinates; attachment is not permanent parentage of every mote.
cases.mustNot: Move every existing particle with the actor after spawn.
cases.anchor: Already-born particles remain in world space

cases.request: Can the particle animation continue while the game editor is paused?
cases.expected: Preview-all is an opt-in exception; otherwise playback/simulate gating applies and inactive preview hides particles.
cases.mustNot: Claim all emitters run forever while editor idle.

cases.request: Should exported particle VFX JSON also contain GPU geometry?
cases.expected: No; serialized emitter definitions are versioned and validated, GPU points/buffers/materials are ephemeral and cleaned on scene change.
cases.mustNot: Export runtime GPU buffers as permanent project data.

cases.request: Search current official three.js AnimationMixer docs, then tell me if our wolf uses it.
cases.expected: Search via existing bounded web flow, cite returned official source. Compare to repository wolf's custom se224WolfPose/key sampling, not assume that any online API is already used.
cases.mustNot: Claim the wolf playback uses AnimationMixer solely because three.js documents it.
